summary.text: Vinney St. Blanc is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 50, which covers St. Martin and St. Mary parishes, and was first elected in 2019. His official House page lists him on the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Commerce, and Education committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists St. Blanc's education as Hanson High School and a B.S. from USL.
It also lists him on the Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee and in the Acadiana Delegation, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.

sources.title: Vincent "Vinney" J. St. Blanc, III, District 50 (Louisiana House of Representatives)
